'''Jeremy Gray''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Denver World Qualifier warm-up tournament]] on 29 June 2001, according to Jason Keen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2618">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-12-parker-06-29-01-the-whos-keen-showd2618/ parker-06-29-01-the-whos-keen-show], DeckTech (Jason "Qui" Keen, 12 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-12-parker-06-29-01-the-whos-keen-showd2618/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
